test_title: PYST 18 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 19 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two figures given on the left side of (::) are related with some logic/rule/relation. Select the missing figure on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same logic/rule/relation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18cda9ceb34e70a421951047da60aea1caa37a0e17c514630e3e2ad2a68b11f6.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The pattern in each box involves a **clockwise rotation** of three elements, with the element in the bottom-left position being replaced by a new one in the top-left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2616c8173d3a1b9994d02c2de3ba4a67f9d6eaa95940cec20c0e52989953d1dd.png] 

**Option 1: ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a61b27dc70ee34568dc15c5d34cd91f6696fd4894b10167a7e5e3e364e96ee2.png] 

Top-left: New element 

Top-right: 8 

Bottom-right: 5 

Bottom-left: Circle 
Perfectly follows the clockwise rotation and replacement rule

**Option 2: ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1acadbced7ca6ee74bbac2e19f97e2e40a7ef270d247ac77d622ef7fff414f55.png] 

Top-left: 8 Should be the new element

Top-right: 5 Top-right should have 8

Bottom-right: Circle Bottom-right should have 5

Bottom-left: Arrow Should be replaced by new element
 Does not follow the pattern

**Option 3: ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd5b81c9573c24d079b93f792bbb885e6b9eb1e53710e186da451077048390d0.png] 

Top-left: Circle Should be the new element

Top-right: 8 

Bottom-right: 5 

Bottom-left: Arrow Should be replaced
 Partially follows the rotation but bottom-left not replaced correctly

**Option 4: ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4011ca24332066e827f4edf9a9acc00890fbbd7d3025d290088c3d237d46d5d2.png] 

Top-left: 5 Should be new element

Top-right: Circle Should be 8

Bottom-right: 8 Should be 5

Bottom-left: Arrow Should be replaced
Completely misaligned

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
